changelog:
geekbi-temu-keyword-search-skill 0.1.0 – Initial Release

- Provides Temu keyword search and analysis based on authentic GeekBI data.
- Supports searching for specific keywords, hot keywords, blue ocean keywords, new keywords, and market opportunity analysis.
- Ensures strict use of site IDs, category IDs, and accurate filters; does not infer category IDs from names.
- Always clarifies sample size, missing/zero values, and data update time in results.
- Results include both a concise conclusion and supporting data, with all clickable keywords formatted as required.
- Fully reuses GeekBI Temu Skills login state and handles query pauses per standard workflow.
